target.description: The target tensor representing the true categorical labels. Its shape should match the shape of the `output` tensor except for the last dimension.
constraints: The shape of the `output` tensor except for the last dimension

output.description: The output tensor representing the predicted probabilities or logits. Its shape should match the shape of the `target` tensor except for the last dimension.
constraints: The shape of the `target` tensor except for the last dimension

from_logits.description: (optional) Whether `output` is a tensor of logits or probabilities. Set it to `True` if `output` represents logits; otherwise, set it to `False` if `output` represents probabilities. Defaults to `False`.

axis.description: (optional) The axis along which the categorical cross-entropy is computed. Defaults to `-1`, which corresponds to the last dimension of the tensors.
constraints: The axis along which the categorical cross-entropy is computed. Defaults to `-1`, which corresponds to the last dimension of the tensors.

output.description: The computed categorical cross-entropy loss between `target` and `output`.
